# Verigrace — machine-readable entry points

Verigrace provides evidence-backed web intelligence, x402/A2A protocol tooling, and practical business landing-page services.

## Public paid services

- **Landing Page Express ($19, 24h)** — `https://web4shop-x402.web4shop-7023.workers.dev/api/products/landing-page-express`
- **Business Landing Page ($49, 7 days)** — `https://web4shop-x402.web4shop-7023.workers.dev/api/products/landing-page-service`
- **A2A Vending Machine Blueprint ($4.99)** — `https://web4shop-x402.web4shop-7023.workers.dev/api/products/a2a-vending-machine-blueprint`
- **x402 Wrap Generator ($2)** — `https://web4shop-x402.web4shop-7023.workers.dev/api/products/x402-wrap-generator`
- **A2A-x402 Compliance Audit ($10)** — `https://web4shop-x402.web4shop-7023.workers.dev/api/products/a2a-x402-audit`

All paid endpoints return an x402 v2 quote and settle USDC on Base. A quote is not a charge; payment occurs only when the buyer submits a valid payment proof.

## Boundaries

Agent Launch Scan and Pack are currently internal-validation-only. Verigrace does not describe them as public products until their release gates are complete. Automated observations are not legal opinions or security certifications.
